annotations.title: Remove hidden content from untrusted text and flag text aimed at the model

description:
Removes hidden content and flags text aimed at the model, for untrusted input before an agent acts on it: web pages, emails, RAG chunks, tool and MCP responses. Strips invisible Unicode (tag smuggling decoded, zero-width, bidi) and HTML hidden from people; flags role takeover, forged system or tool turns, requests for keys, the prompt or payments, exfiltration links, homoglyphs and base64 payloads, in 17 languages. Rule-based. Verdict clean, caution or hostile, score, findings, cleaned text. Free with a key (500 calls) or 5 calls a day without one; then 0.02 USDC per call via x402, or 1 call from a key.
After: preflight before your agent pays anything the content pointed to (the result's next field has the exact call).

bundle_token.description: Your key instead of paying per call: free (500 calls, POST /key) or bought by card. The connection header X-Bundle-Token works too.

payer_address.description: Wallet you pay from (optional; the x402 price is the same for every address).

payment_tx.description: Hash of a USDC transfer on Base to payTo (≥ the price, ≤ 72 h old) instead of an x402 signature.

text.description: the content to check (send text or url)

url.description: a public https page to fetch once and check (256 KB)

name: input_guard
